v1-37.candidate: And the Lord was angry with me also because of you, saying: You shall not enter there either.
v1-37.close: And the Lord was angry with me also for your sakes, saying: You shall not enter there either.

v2-35.candidate: Only the livestock we took as plunder, and the spoil of the cities we took.
v2-35.close: Only the livestock we took as plunder, and the spoil of the cities we took.
